string.text: Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
USM calibration
Individual fitting of weapon parts allows you to achieve higher accuracy of hits when shooting.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts makes the trigger travel shorter and the trigger itself softer.This allows you to fire at a higher rate.
Muffler thread
Replacing the barrel with an elongated one, with a special thread designed for screwing on a muffler.
Barrel replacement

Replacing a standard barrel with an analogue made of a modern special alloy of increased strength makes it possible to achieve greater pressure of powder gases and, therefore, increase the speed of the bullet.
Plastic store
This product of modern technology allows you to carry a little more with you than other useful things.
Plastic parts
Replacing some standard metal body parts with analogues made of heat-resistant plastic can significantly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Rubberized handle
Replacing the linings with more modern foreign analogues has a beneficial effect on the ease of holding the weapon and the accuracy of firing from it.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Recoil compensation system
Allows you to significantly reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
